diagram_math_checks.justification: Read full local def-na-contravariant-piola-map Definition and full assigned lemma. F_K maps reference open simplex widehat K bijectively to K, with invertible constant A_K and J_K=det(A_K)>0. P_K maps C^1(overline widehat K;R^d) to C^1(overline K;R^d) by (P_K widehat v)(x)=J_K^{-1}A_K widehat v(F_K^{-1}(x)); the downward left arrow has precisely this direction. Affine maps extend to the closures.

Divergence of each indicated C^1 vector field is a continuous scalar function on its respective open simplex, giving the top C(widehat K) and bottom C(K) objects. The right downward arrow sends q on widehat K to x -> J_K^{-1}q(F_K^{-1}(x)) on K. This is scalar push-forward/pull-forward, not the inverse vector pull-back J_K A_K^{-1}v composed with F_K; no map direction was substituted.

Full local proof step 1.1 and local chain-rule theorem give partial_x_i = sum_k (A_K^{-1})_ki partial_widehat_x_k. Hence div(P_K widehat v) = J_K^{-1} sum_i,k,j (A_K^{-1})_ki(A_K)_ij partial_k widehat v_j composed with F_K^{-1} = J_K^{-1}(div widehat v) composed with F_K^{-1}. Thus both paths agree with precisely J_K^{-1}; neither J_K nor an absolute-value/sign convention replaces it.

The supplier Definition fixes consistent oriented normals and n ds=J_K A_K^{-T} widehat n d widehat s. Full local proof 2.1 uses this cofactor formula. Pairing it with J_K^{-1}A_K widehat v cancels determinants and gives (A_K widehat v) dot (A_K^{-T} widehat n)=widehat v dot widehat n, pointwise under F_K. Integrating corresponding facets yields the stated equality without a sign reversal. The square depicts divergence commutativity only and introduces no extra boundary arrow or unproved flux relation.
